question: Cost of the same retained-evidence diagnostic service under a finite compiled implementation and independent incremental SMT
outputs: old observation sufficiency and recorded-verdict agreement
two opposed new-verdict completions when insufficient
all inclusion-minimal robust additional block sets
Procurement witnesses preserve original repeated activity sequence and every literal retained field; cached canonical witnesses are lifted per request within the timed batch
robust_additional_set: A set A of unread blocks such that ANY two supported completions agreeing on retained observations and on A have the same new verdict. All returned sets are inclusion-minimal. This is a nonadaptive worst-case query guarantee based only on observations, NOT an actual unread-value-conditioned minimum or an optimal adaptive plan.
domain: Unchanged complete finite domain; old verdict is checked and NEVER asserted as an extra new-domain restriction; truthful retained observations and unchanged source snapshot are external assumptions.

workloads.unique: Every distinct old-valid observation class in the procurement receipts (20 per target) or GS1 complete declared finite domain (805/535/2085). No result-cache reuse between queries, incremental formula/solver reuse allowed.
workloads.weighted: Every one of the 50931 original procurement receipts in source order; GS1 one fixed old-policy receipt per 324/216/648 synthetic model states. Both methods may cache entire semantic reports by observation class. GS1 frequencies are authored nonempirical finite-domain frequencies.

timing.order: rotate the full model/workload/method job list each round; reverse method order on alternating rounds
timing.process: one fresh child process per job; affinity to minimum available CPU; process_time_ns and perf_counter_ns
timing.setup: Common framework imports and configuration/input loading precede timers. Finite compilation or direct SMT construction are timed; the additional cold z3 dependency import is separately recorded and included in setup/batch totals. Core setup/batch subtract ONLY this import for sensitivity.
timing.first_report: First query including its report JSON serialization; both exclusive and setup-inclusive times
timing.batch: Setup plus every query, per-request literal witness lifting and canonical report JSON serialization; source request binding included. Excludes disk writes, input normalization/receipt-envelope validation and source retrieval. Class cache stores semantic diagnostics only; literal reports regenerated each request.
timing.memory: Linux child ru_maxrss KiB sampled after setup, first report, batch and before independent raw validation; absolute process HWM, NOT method-only allocation
timing.serialization: Canonical UTF8 JSON report encoding measured separately within batch
timing.validation: Independent raw predicate checks of old sufficiency, classification, witness soundness and robust-set sufficiency/irreducibility after timed batch. Every emitted procurement completion is additionally lifted and checked against original retained literal values and raw predicates; replayed report digest must match timed digest. Cost reported separately.
timing.statistics: All raw rows; medians and within-round paired deltas only, no host-population inference

boundary: Diagnostic-only service. No online acquisition/recovery, durable report writes, network, cryptographic authentication or unseen-domain membership validation. Robust query sets support a later caller; no simulated production throughput claim.
freeze: Fresh output directory only; all code/protocol/input hashes captured before execution; no outcome-dependent target selection or timing exclusions. Bug fixes require a fresh run with prior evidence retained.
